GRAPHICS QUALITY PRESETS & COMPETITIVE VISIBILITY AUTO-ADAPTIVE
Master Quality Tier Auto-Adaptive dynamically scales quality to hold target FPS, or lock a manual preset
Enemy Highlight & Target Color (Colorblind / Pro Visibility) Recolors 3D enemy bots & targets for instant peripheral contrast (Pro Yellow is #1 in VCT)
Arena Lighting & Time of Day Standard Daylight, Competitive Zero-Fog Clarity, Night Cyber Glow, or a low golden sun at Sunset or Dawn
Weather Map: each map's own weather (rain on Bind, storms on Split, snow on Icebox, sandstorms on Haven, leaves on Ascent and Lotus). Or pick one weather for every map. Off on Low quality
ULTRA REALISM OFF
Ultra Realism (above Cinematic) A separate graphics tier for a grounded, physically plausible look, never picked by Auto. Aimed at 60 FPS at 1080p on a mid-range graphics card. Needs WebGL 2: without it, Cinematic is used. The switches below choose its features
Sky & Fog Atmospheric scattering with a sun disc and clouds for each time of day; it lights the scene and adds height fog
Materials Generated PBR surfaces (concrete, plaster, stone, wood, metal, glass) mapped in world space
Ascent Detail Frames, trims, roof tiles, pipes, lamps and props on Ascent (decor only: no collision)
Lighting Baked ambient occlusion and bounce light, a sharp near shadow cascade, and the light of the glowing wall lanterns
Post Processing 4x multisampled anti-aliasing, full-resolution ambient occlusion and automatic exposure
Reflections Sharper reflections on wet floors and the surroundings reflected in metal
Guns & Hands PBR metal and polymer, jointed fingers, brass casings and muzzle smoke
Characters Smooth jointed bodies in place of box figures (hitboxes unchanged)
Effects Soft particles, lit smoke and impact debris that depends on the surface
CAMERA, RESOLUTION & GRANULAR GRAPHICS 1920×1080

75°

100%
Dynamic Shadow Map Resolution Controls real-time directional sun shadows across walls and agents
Moving Shadow Refresh Rate How frequently moving bot shadows re-render per second
Surface Detail Procedural grime, contact shading & roughness on map walls (AUTO follows quality; OFF on Low)
High Detail Maps Textured walls & crates, rounded edges, soft shading at wall bases, pipes, vents & rubble (costs some FPS; off on Low)
High Detail Characters & Guns Rounded, more detailed bots, wingmen, guns & hands. Looks only: hitboxes are unchanged (off on Low)
Enhanced Animations Bots and wingmen step, aim, reload, cast, plant, climb and react by where they are hit; your gun and body move with your real speed, jumps and landings. Looks only: hitboxes and timings are unchanged
Agent Identity Each agent's own look: sleeves, gloves and gestures in first person, outfits on bots and wingmen, the kill cam and the MVP card, and its own sound palette. Off: the V2.2 picture in a match. Looks only: hitboxes and timings are unchanged
Weapon Animations V2.3: tactical and empty reloads with a visible magazine, draws and inspections by gun class. Classic: the V2.2 clips. Reload, draw and fire timings are the same in both
Glow Halos Additive glow around ability cores, spike, ult orbs & enemy muzzle flashes (one draw call)
Ability Effects High Fidelity draws abilities with lit, volumetric effects; Auto uses it in Ultra Realism only. Now: CLASSIC

100%
Reduce Flashes (Accessibility) Softens flashbangs and full-screen colour flashes, and stops the low-health pulse (for light sensitivity)
Camera Shake A small shake from nearby explosions and blasts (always off with Reduce Flashes)
Kill Cam & Highlights After a death, replay the last seconds from your killer's side (Space or Ⓐ skips). In Match mode, replay the best play of each round
Show Body See your legs and body in your agent's colour when you look down, and your shadow on the ground
Slide Crouch while sprinting to slide low and fast; jump out of a slide to keep the speed
Mantle Jump into a ledge or crate up to chest height while moving forward to climb onto it
Breakable Props Glass panes that shatter and explosive barrels that blow up when shot (they come back next round, or after 30 s)
Skip Menu On Start Go straight into the game when it loads instead of the start screen (Esc still opens the menu)

80m

BOT AI DIFFICULTY & COMBAT REACTION TIER
Enemy Bot Skill & Reaction Speed Adjust bot accuracy, fire-rate cadence, strafe speed and tactics (Iron: hides only when hurt, never flanks; Radiant: flanks often, peeks pre-aimed)
Bots Use Map Mechanics Bots take Bind's teleporters when quicker, climb Icebox's and Split's ropes to hold a deck, open Lotus's doors on their way (defenders sometimes shut them behind them) and, attacking, shoot Lotus's breakable wall open
Bot Utility Classic: bots cast what and when they did in V2.2, with a windup and a throw you can see. Agent: bots use their agent's utility (a rusher's flash and push, smokes on chokes, a flash before a peek, slows on entries). Ranked always plays Classic
